log.text: Mira the Halfling (Lightfoot) Rogue joins the party.
Torvald the Dwarf (Hill) Fighter joins the party.
Elowen the Elf (High) Wizard joins the party.
The adventure begins.

Rain hammers the shutters of the Drowned Lantern. Old Brannock wipes the same mug for the third time, watching the door.
Somewhere below the floorboards, water drips in a slow, patient rhythm.
I slide onto a stool at the bar and order whatever is warm.
"Who rings a bell under the sea, old man?"
Brannock stops wiping. "Nobody living," he says, and sets down a steaming bowl of fish stew in front of Mira.
Can I tell if the dripping comes from a cellar?
You can try. Listen closely to where it comes from.
Elowen rolled Wisdom (Perception) check: 14 +3 = 17 — success
Beneath the long table, a trapdoor. The planks around it are wet and newer than the rest.
